entities.summary: The Imenkovo culture was an archaeological culture that, from the 4th to 7th centuries, covered much of the Middle Volga region, including parts of modern-day Tatarstan, Mordovia, Chuvashia and Samara Oblast. It was named after the Imenkovo settlement in Tatarstan.
